card.name: Reference and credit lines in health articles
card.fires_on: Small words in the closing parts of patient-education pages, such as "Available at" before a web address, the credit line after "Nucleus Medical", and "Last reviewed ... by". Also fires on a few scattered spots like "increases your chance".
